note: Reference: opsezy VatMath (decimal baht, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero): AddVat = round(ex*(100+r)/100, 2); Split: ex = round(incl*100/(100+r), 2), vat = incl - ex. Every case, including its midpoint flag, is recomputed from that formula by VatMathTests, so this file is checked against the reference rather than trusted. 'midpoint' means the unrounded value falls exactly halfway between two satang. Split has no midpoints at most rates: it needs (10000 + rateBps) divisible by 32, so only the 16 bps (0.16%) rate exercises Split midpoints. AddVat midpoints exist at every nonzero rate except 16 bps; at 700 bps they are every ex = 50 mod 100 satang (ex=50 -> 53.5 -> 54). Themia.ETax runs in satang + basis points and must match every case.
